name: moving-boundary-hx-evaporator-resolves-two-phase-and-superheat-zones
source:

TwoPhaseSource SRC(fluid$=R134a, mdot=0.02, P=350000, x=0.25)
TwoPhaseSink SNK()

connect(SRC.out, EV.in)
connect(EV.out, SNK.in)
connect(EV.wall, WALL.port)
